description: How a lower or upper bound is applied to a clause's scores during min_max normalization.

enum.name: apply
enum.description: Normalize against the bound without modifying the original scores. A score beyond the bound falls back to the clause's actual minimum or maximum score, so it is normalized by the standard min-max formula.

enum.name: clip
enum.description: Normalize against the bound, and clamp a score beyond it: a score below a lower bound becomes 0.0 and a score above an upper bound becomes 1.0.

enum.name: ignore
enum.description: Do not apply a bound to this clause; use the standard min-max formula.
